title: Cement HSN Code and GST Rate: White Cement, OPC and Clinker
summary: Check cement HSN code 2523 and the 18% GST rate, including white cement, OPC, PPC and clinker codes, invoice requirements and a GST calculation example.
body_markdown:

### Key Takeaways


- The main cement HSN heading is 2523. Cement and clinker under this heading attract 18% GST, effective from 22 September 2025.
- White Portland cement uses 252321, with the full Indian tariff item 25232100. Cement clinker uses 252310 or 25231000.
- Intra-state supplies generally attract 9% CGST plus 9% SGST; interstate supplies attract 18% IGST.
- Use the HSN digits required for your turnover and transaction. Correct classification does not by itself establish ITC eligibility.


##


What Is the HSN Code for Cement?


The primary HSN code for cement is **2523** . This HSN heading covers hydraulic cements including Portland cement, white cement, slag cement, aluminous cement, supersulphate cement and similar hydraulic cements. Whether supplied as cement or in the form of clinkers, they fall into HSN 2523.


This HSN code is significant for manufacturers, dealers, contractors, builders, exporters and accountants as they will need to apply the correct GST rate on their supplies. As of **September 22, 2025** , cement under HSN 2523 attracts a GST rate of **18%** , down from the previous 28%. Using the correct HSN code on tax invoices, e-invoicing, purchase records and GST returns will help businesses achieve accuracy and avoid errors in GST compliance.


##


What Is an HSN Code?


HSN is short for Harmonized System of Nomenclature. It is a standardized classification system utilized by various countries and organizations to classify goods for customs, trade and GST purposes. Our guide to[HSN and SAC codes](https://www.cashfree.com/blog/hsn-sac-code-gst/) explains how goods and services are classified.


When using an HSN code on your GST invoice, it identifies the goods you’re supplying. It helps determine the proper tax rate applied to those goods and supports accurate e-way bills and GST returns. A correct HSN code alone does not establish input tax credit (ITC) eligibility.


For cement, the appropriate HSN heading is **2523** and is located in Chapter 25 of the HSN classification system. Chapter 25 categorizes goods such as salts, sulphur, earths, stone, plastering materials, lime and cement.

##


Cement HSN Code and GST Rate in India


As previously mentioned the main HSN code for cement is **2523** . The GST rate on cement and cement clinkers (under this heading) is **18%** .


For an inter-state supply: 18%[IGST](https://www.cashfree.com/blog/what-is-igst/) typically applies.


For an intra-state supply: 9%[CGST](https://www.cashfree.com/blog/what-is-cgst-central-goods-and-services-tax/) + 9% SGST typically applies.


Exports of cement typically qualify as zero-rated but would depend on applicable GST conditions and documentation.


Review GST rates and classifications against the latest notifications, GST rate schedules and seller product descriptions. Heading 2523 appears in the 18% schedule of[Notification No. 9/2025-Integrated Tax (Rate)](https://courier.cbic.gov.in/ECCS/advisory/2025/NOTIFICATION%20NO.%209_2025-INTEGRATED%20TAX%20%28RATE%29%20-1759486719.pdf) .


##


HSN Codes for Different Types of Cement


Although **2523** is the primary heading, the appropriate sub-heading depends on the type of cement being supplied.


**HSN Code** **Description** **GST Rate**


2523 Cement (including cement clinker) 18%


2523 10 Cement clinker 18%


2523 21 White cement (whether or not artificially coloured) 18%


2523 29 Other Portland cement 18%


2523 30 Aluminous cement 18%


2523 90 Other hydraulic cements 18%


Commonly used codes include:


- **252329** : ordinary Portland cement and other variants.
- **252321** : white Portland cement.
- **252310** : cement clinkers.


### White Cement HSN Code: 252321 and 25232100


The HSN code of white Portland cement is **252321** . The full eight-digit code of white Portland cement is **25232100** .


This code includes white Portland cement, whether or not artificially coloured. White cement-based putty and other formulated products need separate classification checks.


White cement is commonly utilized in decorative finishes, tiles, flooring, precast products and architectural applications. White Portland cement falls under the larger heading of 2523 cements and therefore attracts 18% GST.


Sellers should list a correct description of white cement on their invoices. Use **2523** , **252321** or **25232100** according to the applicable invoice or customs reporting requirement; eight digits are not mandatory on every domestic GST invoice.


### HSN Code of Cement Clinkers: 252310 and 25231000


The HSN code of cement clinkers is **252310** . The eight-digit code of cement clinkers is **25231000** .


Cement clinkers are intermediate products that are utilized in production of cement. They are produced by heating limestone and other raw materials in a kiln after which they are ground alongside gypsum and other materials to produce cement.


Similar to cement, cement clinker also attracts 18% GST. Suppliers, traders and importers must ensure that cement clinkers are not incorrectly classified under any other mineral or industrial good headings.


### HSN Code for Cement: OPC, PPC, Slag and Aluminous Cement


Cement is not a single uniform product. Classification depends upon composition and manufacturing stage.


- **Ordinary Portland cement (OPC)** : typically classified under HSN 252329.
- **Portland pozzolana cement (PPC)** : typically classified under HSN 252329.
- **White cement** : classified under HSN 252321.
- **Slag cement** : classified under HSN 2523 depending upon composition; Portland slag cement has the Indian tariff item **25232940** .
- **Aluminous cement** : classified under HSN 252330.
- **Cement clinkers** : classified under HSN 252310.


Match your invoice description with the product you have supplied. The[Indian Trade Portal cement classification](https://indiantradeportal.in/vs.jsp?pid=14&productID=10496) lists detailed Portland cement tariff items, including **25232910** for dry OPC and **25232930** for PPC.


##


How to Select the Correct HSN Code for Cement


1. Identify whether the product supplied is cement or clinker (cement clinker);
2. Decide what type of cement is being supplied: white cement, Portland cement, alumina cement or other hydraulic cements;
3. Match to corresponding subheadings under HSN code 2523.
4. Use a consistent product description on the invoice, e-way bill, purchase order and GST return.
5. Validate the GST rate and required HSN digits using the latest notifications and invoicing rules.


For example: If seller is supplying white cement then he can use HSN 252321; seller can use HSN 252329 for OPC/PPC; manufacturer supplying clinkers can use HSN 252310.


##


When Did the Cement GST Rate Change from 28% to 18%?


GST rate on cement under HSN code 2523 has been reduced from 28% to 18%. This reduction is effective since September 22, 2025.


This GST rate reduction will have an impact on the pricing, working capital planning, input tax credit and customer communication for all sellers. Contractors and builders are advised to check quotations, purchase orders and current contracts to understand how this new GST rate will apply to supplies made after the effective date. Supplies spanning the rate change need a time-of-supply review.

##


Cement GST Invoice Requirements and Record-Keeping


All sellers of cement should verify that their tax invoice includes information about each item sold, including: product description, HSN code, GST rate, taxable value and amount of tax payable. Check the buyer’s GSTIN using[GST verification](https://www.cashfree.com/gst-verification/) and confirm the relevant[GST state code](https://www.cashfree.com/blog/gst-state-code-list/) before invoicing.


The main compliance issues are as follows:


- HSN code used for both cement and cement clinkers must be HSN code 2523.
- Correct sub heading as per requirement needs to be selected like HSN code 252321 for white cement and HSN code 252310 for clinkers.
- Charge GST of 18% i.e. 9% CGST + 9% SGST for intrastate supplies.
- Charge GST of 18% IGST for interstate supplies.
- Mention correct HSN code on tax invoices, e-invoices and e-way bills wherever required.
- Maintain delivery challans, transport documents and e-way bill records.
- Reconcile sales and output tax in GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B, and review eligible ITC against GSTR-2B and purchase records.


### How Many HSN Digits Should a Cement Invoice Include?


The number of HSN digits depends on the supplier’s aggregate turnover in the preceding financial year. Under the official HSN invoicing requirements, suppliers up to ₹5 crore use four digits on B2B tax invoices, while those above ₹5 crore use six digits on tax invoices. Import-export reporting generally uses the full eight-digit tariff item.


##


Documents Required for Selling Cement


Common documents that cement businesses must keep to support both the sale of the cement and the GST treatment of the sale are:


- Tax invoice or e-invoice.
- Delivery challan, where applicable.
- E-way bill for eligible movements of goods.
- Purchase order and delivery acknowledgement.
- Transport documents, such as a lorry receipt or consignment note.
- GST returns and input tax credit records.
- Export documents, such as a shipping bill and export invoice, for exports.


Keeping matching records supports a business’s ability to substantiate eligible input tax credit claims and respond to GST notices or audit queries.[Bank reconciliation](https://www.cashfree.com/blog/bank-reconciliation-meaning-statement-and-how-it-works/) also helps match customer receipts with bank credits.


##


Cement GST Calculation: Dealer Invoice Example


If a cement dealer in Maharashtra delivers 200 bags of OPC to a contractor in Maharashtra, assume the taxable value is **₹90,000** . This is an illustrative invoice, not a cement price quote.


Since the supply is intra-state, the dealer charges:


Invoice component Amount


Taxable value ₹90,000


CGST at 9% ₹8,100


SGST at 9% ₹8,100


Total GST ₹16,200


Invoice total **₹1,06,200**


The dealer should select an appropriate HSN code for OPC which is most likely 252329 and clearly write down the product name in the invoice.


In case the same dealer delivers the cement to a contractor in Karnataka, the transaction is inter-state. Therefore, the dealer will charge 18% IGST = rupees sixteen thousand two hundred against a taxable value of ₹90,000. You can cross-check the arithmetic with the[GST calculator](https://www.cashfree.com/gst-calculator/) .


##


Avoiding Common Mistakes in Classification and Taxation of Cement under GST


Most companies encounter issues in the classification and billing of their products under GST which can have implications for their GST obligations.


- Using only HSN 2523 when the applicable reporting requirement calls for six or eight digits.
- Incorrectly applying the previous 28% GST rate after the rates were revised.
- Misclassifying white cement or clinker as a separate product outside of the HSN code 2523.
- Incorrectly charging CGST and SGST on an interstate supply instead of IGST.
- Failing to match the company’s purchase records, sales records, e-way bill data, and GST returns for cement.
- Neglecting specific compliance requirements based on the product specifications for specialized types of cement.

##


FAQs


#### What is the HSN code for cement?


The HSN code for cement is 2523. The HSN code includes Portland cement, white cement, slag cement, aluminous cement, supersulphate cement and other hydraulic cements. The HSN code also includes cement clinker.


#### What is the cement HSN code and GST rate?


Effective September 22, 2025, cement under the HSN code 2523 attracts 18% GST. In general, for intra-state sales, this would be broken down into a 9% CGST and 9% SGST charge. For inter-state sales this would be broken down into an 18% IGST charge.


#### What is the white cement HSN code?


The HSN code for white Portland cement is 252321. Generally the eight digit code will be 25232100 for white cement whether or not artificially coloured.


#### What is the HSN code for cement clinkers?


The HSN code for cement clinkers is 252310. Generally the eight digit code will be 25231000.


#### Is GST different for white cement and ordinary Portland cement?


No. As both white cement and ordinary Portland cement fall under the same HSN classification 2523 they also attract an 18% GST subject to the use of the correct sub heading on the invoice.


#### Which HSN code should I use for OPC and PPC?


Generally OPC and PPC are classified under HSN code 252329 which includes other Portland cement. All companies should verify product specifications and the latest GST classification before issuing invoices for products that fall within this category.


#### Must I include the HSN code on my cement invoice?


Yes. The HSN code must be included on most GST invoices for cement. The number of digits required may depend upon your supplier’s aggregate turnover and applicable invoicing rules.


#### Can exports of cement qualify as zero-rated under GST?


Exports of goods including cement generally qualify as zero rated under GST subject to appropriate conditions, documentation and export procedure. Business owners should confirm with their GST practitioner or tax advisor what treatment is required.
